units.source_text: 一爿寺庙，通常是仰仗对住持的尊敬之念，来维持寺庙的秩序的。

en.t: A temple usually maintains its order by relying on the respect felt toward its chief priest.

units.source_text: 过去一年里，尽管我承蒙老师的多方关照，但我对他却没有涌起过深切的敬爱之情。

en.t: Over the past year, although I had received many kinds of care from my teacher, no deep feeling of reverence or affection for him had arisen in me.

units.source_text: 光是这样还好，可自母亲点燃野心之火以来，17岁的我有时竟以批判的目光来看待老师。

en.t: That alone would have been tolerable, but ever since my mother had lit the fire of ambition in me, I, at seventeen, sometimes even looked at my teacher with a critical eye.
